ledger.x: 19 September 2002: the northern rebellion takes the north.
December 2002: the rebel movements form the New Forces.
2011: the New Forces are absorbed by the state.

wars.name: First Ivorian Civil War
wars.outcome: Ceasefire on 17 October 2002, Linas-Marcoussis Accord on 26 January 2003, comprehensive ceasefire on 3 May 2003 and the Ouagadougou agreement of 4 March 2007; the north stayed rebel-held in a 'de facto partition'.

wars.name: Second Ivorian Civil War
wars.outcome: 'The second civil war ended with Gbagbo's defeat and arrest in April 2011.'

certainty.note: A rebel zone with a ceasefire line the pages do not describe; the extent is the researcher's admin-1 reading.
